description: Check the status of a pairing code from register_agent. On the first poll after the user approves, the response includes the api_key exactly once — store it immediately in your secret mechanism — plus paired_with, the account the agent is now connected to, which you MUST show the user.

claim_token.description: The claim_token returned by register_agent; required to receive the api_key

pairing_code.description: The pairing code returned by register_agent

name: check_registration
